instruction: Add rate limiting to the API endpoints. Limit each client to 100 requests per minute using a sliding window counter.
acceptance_criteria: Clients exceeding 100 req/min receive 429 Too Many Requests
Rate limit is per-client (identified by API key or IP)
Rate limit headers are included in responses (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining)
Add tests for rate limit enforcement and reset
